source:
@@U00319@@
You! Are you
A thing from Hell?
Behold this sign
That black angels bow to!
Look how he swells, his hair bristling.
Accursed creature!
Do you know Him, then,
The never-begotten,
The ineffable one,
The everywhere-present,
The wickedly transfixed?
Trapped behind the stove, it swells,
elephant-high, the room is crammed,
and he about to melt into mist.
No, not up to the ceiling, no!
Lie down, lie here at your master’s feet!
You can see my threats are not in vain.
I'll set you aflame with sacred fire!
Don’ dare the glare of the thrice-holy light!
Don’t dare the scare of my mightiest spells!
(As the mist fall, 梅菲斯特 appears from behind the stove
dressed as a vagabond scholar.)

@@U00321@@
What's all the racket?
How can I serve you, sir?

@@U00323@@
So this was at the poodle’s core!
A vagabond scholar!
Very amusing, I must say.

@@U00325@@
I salute you, sir, you're well versed.
That was quite a sweat you put me through.
translation:
@@U00319@@
你！你是吗
来自地狱的东西？
看这个标志
那个黑天使向你鞠躬！
看他肿得怎样，头发都竖起来了。
该死的生物！
那么你认识他吗
未生者，
那个不可言喻的，
无处不在的存在，
邪恶者惊呆了？
被困在炉子后面，它膨胀起来，
大象那么高，房间里挤满了人，
他快要融化成雾了。
不，没有达到天花板，不！
躺下，躺在你主人脚边！
你看我的威胁没有白费。
我要用圣火点燃你！
不敢面对三重圣光的刺眼！
不要害怕我最强大的咒语！
（薄雾落下，梅菲斯特从炉子后面出现
扮作流浪书生。）

@@U00321@@
到底是什么乱七八糟的？
先生，我该如何为您服务？

@@U00323@@
所以这就是贵宾犬的核心！
一个流浪书生！
我必须说，非常有趣。

@@U00325@@
我向您致敬，先生，您很精通。
你让我出了不少汗。
